title: Famine, Sword, and Exile

questions.question: What did the Lord command Jeremiah NOT to do in this place (Jeremiah 16:2)?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:2 (ESV): "You shall not take a wife, nor shall you have sons or daughters in this place."

questions.question: "For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and daughters who are born in this place... They shall die of deadly... They shall not be lamented, nor shall they be..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:3-4 (ESV): "They shall die of deadly diseases. They shall not be lamented, nor shall they be buried."

questions.question: "They shall be as dung on the surface of the ground. They shall perish by the... and by famine, and their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the air and for the beasts of the earth."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:4 (ESV): "They shall perish by the sword and by famine,"

questions.question: The Lord told Jeremiah: "Do not enter the house of... , or go to lament or bemoan them, for I have taken away my peace from this people, my steadfast love and mercy, declares the Lord."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:5 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord: Do not enter the house of mourning, or go to lament or bemoan them,"

questions.question: "Both great and small shall die in this land. They shall not be buried, and no one shall lament for them or... himself or make himself... for them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:6 (ESV): "and no one shall lament for them or cut himself or make himself bald for them."

questions.question: "No one shall break bread for the mourner, to comfort him for the dead, nor shall anyone give him the cup of... to drink for his father or his mother."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:7 (ESV): "nor shall anyone give him the cup of consolation to drink for his father or his mother."

questions.question: Where else was Jeremiah forbidden to go, to sit with them, to eat and drink?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:8 (ESV): "You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and drink."

questions.question: "For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will silence in this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the... and the voice of the..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:9 (ESV): "the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride."

questions.question: "And when you tell this people all these words, and they say to you, 'Why has the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us? What is our iniquity?'... then you shall say to them: 'Because your... have forsaken me, declares the Lord,'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:10-11 (ESV): "then you shall say to them: 'Because your fathers have forsaken me, declares the Lord,'"

questions.question: "...and because you have done worse than your fathers, for behold, every one of you follows his stubborn, ... heart, refusing to listen to me."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:12 (ESV): "for behold, every one of you follows his stubborn, evil heart,"

questions.question: "Therefore I will hurl you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you shall serve other gods... for I will show you no..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:13 (ESV): "for I will show you no favor."

questions.question: "Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the Lord, when it shall no longer be said, 'As the Lord lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt,' but 'As the Lord lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the...'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:14-15 (ESV): "but 'As the Lord lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the north country...'"

questions.question: The Lord says he will send for many..., and they shall catch them. And afterward he will send for many..., and they shall hunt them from every mountain and every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:16 (ESV): "Behold, I am sending for many fishers, declares the Lord, and they shall catch them. And afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them"

questions.question: "For my eyes are on all their... They are not hidden from me, nor is their iniquity concealed from my eyes."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:17 (ESV): "For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from me,"

questions.question: "To you shall the nations come from the ends of the earth and say: 'Our fathers have inherited nothing but..., worthless things in which there is no profit.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 16:19 (ESV): "Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, worthless things in which there is no profit."

key_verse_text: O Lord, my strength and my stronghold, my refuge in the day of trouble, to you shall the nations come from the ends of the earth and say: "Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, worthless things in which there is no profit."
